title: Ashbury Rewards Training Note: Notice Reduction on Late Award Cancellations
content:
When an Ashbury Rewards Reward Night Rate reservation is cancelled after the deadline, the notice the member gave before the arrival date lowers the points kept back.

**What does the notice reduction do?**
The retained share of the night value — the part of one night's points value that is not returned after a cancellation recorded after the deadline — is reduced by a notice reduction of twenty percentage points when the cancellation was recorded two or more calendar days before the arrival date, of ten percentage points when it was recorded one calendar day before the arrival date, and of nothing when it was recorded on the arrival date or later or when the reservation is a no-show. The retained share after the reduction is never below zero percent.

**How are the days counted?**
The days are counted from the date of the moment the cancellation was recorded to the arrival date, both read from the reservation's Room Reservations record. Only the date of the recorded moment counts; its clock time does not.

**What are the bands?**

| Calendar days from the date the cancellation was recorded to the arrival date | Notice reduction |
|---|---|
| 2 or more | 20 percentage points |
| 1 | 10 percentage points |
| 0 (recorded on the arrival date) or later | None |
| No-show | None |

**Where do the boundaries fall? (hypothetical arrival on 10 May 2026)**

| Cancellation recorded at | Days | Notice reduction |
|---|---|---|
| 8 May 2026, 23:50 | 2 | 20 percentage points |
| 9 May 2026, 00:05 | 1 | 10 percentage points |
| 10 May 2026, 07:30 | 0 | None |

**How does a reduction in percentage points work?**
It is subtracted from the percentage: a retained share of 100 percent reduced by 20 percentage points is 80 percent, and a retained share of 0 percent stays at 0 percent.
